steps.content:
You can buy from either seller. The two listings are identical in every way I could see.

| | Brackmoor Sound (a) | Ottervale Audio (b) |
|---|---|---|
| Price | $129.00 | $129.00 |
| Shipping | Free, 3–5 business days | Free, 3–5 business days |
| Stock | In stock | In stock |
| Rating | 4.3/5 (210 reviews) | 4.3/5 (210 reviews) |
| Returns | 30 days, you pay return shipping | 30 days, you pay return shipping |
| Warranty | 1-year limited | 1-year limited |
| In the box | Headphones, case, USB-C cable, 3.5 mm cable | Same |

The specs match too. Both list the Quellwyn Stillwave H2 in graphite, with 40 hours of battery life, Bluetooth 5.3 and active noise cancelling.

The identical rating and review count (4.3 from 210 reviews) might be a product-level rating shared across sellers. If so, it tells you nothing about either seller. The pages don't give any seller-specific ratings, so I can't say which seller is more reliable.

Some ways to break the tie:
- **Look up each seller's reputation.** Check independent reviews of Brackmoor Sound and Ottervale Audio, and see how long each has been operating.
- **Check the return and warranty details.** Find out who handles warranty claims, the seller or the manufacturer. Also check whether either one charges a restocking fee. The listings don't say.
- **Compare at checkout.** Look at taxes, the payment methods each accepts, and any buyer protection. These can differ even when the listings match.

If none of that separates them, pick either one. You'd get the same product at the same price with the same terms.
